approvalText: Raydot 技术审阅通过：批准固定 6804c9d43fa6161f785240e02943fccaa25c61c5 的集中根因方案、12 项严格原生修约请求及三语流程条款补丁。独立审查已核对原27范围保留、精确新增10文件、原 AC3/门禁/终态限制不变，并核对 activation 原件 cba3→b8ec 及 Git 祖先关系。请现在原生修约并连续推进已授权准备；只有实际真人门槛才返回一次完整绑定。技术审阅如实记 agent:Raydot，不能代 Ray 的真人决定。
acceptanceRefinements: Existing real gate positive/negative ownership, absent actual change cannot be manufactured from scope or hand-filled Summary.
Same path inherited and successor hunks, concurrent verify, legacy raw recorder rejection/non-erasure, failed/completion rollback retaining pre-execution facts.
Actual first failure -> reverify success -> .ai evidence commit -> finish/archive without redundant verification or confirmation; zero matched tests does not qualify.
Native responsibility-origin validation failure stops without fallback to scope. Real current Work Item document gates and own finish/archive remain required.
